parts.zh: M：今晚，我们请到了一位非常特别的嘉宾
M：我们先从您的书谈起吧
W：这本书讲的是科学和技术如何帮助人类将身体能力推向极限
M：但这种比较公平吗？比如说
W：嗯，您说得对。这种比较也许根本无法进行
M：这很有意思。请再多给我们讲讲这些所谓的极限吧
W：世界上已经出现了一些被打破的体育纪录
M：有没有人担心技术会让一些运动员相较于其他人获得不公平的优势？
W：这是一个有意思的问题

items.stem: What do we learn about Anna Sanchez?

choices.text: She is a great athlete.
choices.zh: 她是一名优秀的运动员。

choices.text: She is a famed speaker.
choices.zh: 她是一位著名的演讲者。

choices.text: She is a famous scientist.
choices.zh: 她是一位著名的科学家。

choices.text: She is a noted inventor.
choices.zh: 她是一位知名的发明家。

items.stem: What is the woman's book mainly about?

choices.text: How knowledge of human biochemistry has been evolving.
choices.zh: 人类生物化学知识是如何演变的。

choices.text: How nutrition helps athletes' performance in competitions.
choices.zh: 营养如何帮助运动员在比赛中取得好成绩。

choices.text: How scientific training enables athletes to set new records.
choices.zh: 科学训练如何使运动员创造新纪录。

choices.text: How technology has helped athletes to scale new heights.
choices.zh: 技术如何帮助运动员攀登新高度。

items.stem: What has changed in the past thousands of years?

choices.text: Our physical structures.
choices.zh: 我们的身体结构。

choices.text: Our scientific knowledge.
choices.zh: 我们的科学知识。

choices.text: Our biochemical process.
choices.zh: 我们的生物化学过程。

choices.text: Our concept of nutrition.
choices.zh: 我们的营养概念。

items.stem: What is the man's concern about the use of technology in sports competitions?

choices.text: It may increase the expenses of sports competitions.
choices.zh: 它可能会增加体育比赛的费用。

choices.text: It may lead to athletes' over-reliance on equipment.
choices.zh: 它可能导致运动员过度依赖设备。

choices.text: It may give an unfair advantage to some athletes.
choices.zh: 它可能给某些运动员带来不公平的优势。

choices.text: It may change the nature of sports competitions.
choices.zh: 它可能改变体育比赛的性质。

items.stem: What does the woman think is required to be successful in international trade?

choices.text: Experience.
choices.zh: 经验。

choices.text: Flexibility.
choices.zh: 灵活性。

choices.text: Family background.
choices.zh: 家庭背景。

choices.text: Business connections.
choices.zh: 商业关系。

items.stem: What does the woman say is special about her way of doing trade?

choices.text: Buying directly from factories.
choices.zh: 直接从工厂购买。

choices.text: Shipping goods in bulk by sea.
choices.zh: 通过海运批量运输货物。

choices.text: Having partners in many parts of the world.
choices.zh: 在世界许多地方都有合作伙伴。

choices.text: Using the same container back and forth.
choices.zh: 来回使用同一个集装箱。

items.stem: What does the woman have in both Italy and China?

choices.text: Warehouses.
choices.zh: 仓库。

choices.text: Factories.
choices.zh: 工厂。

choices.text: Investors.
choices.zh: 投资者。

choices.text: Retailers.
choices.zh: 零售商。

items.stem: What does the woman say makes furniture marginally more profitable?

choices.text: Trendy style.
choices.zh: 时尚的风格。

choices.text: Unique design.
choices.zh: 独特的设计。

choices.text: Lower import duties.
choices.zh: 较低的进口关税。

choices.text: Lower shipping costs.
choices.zh: 较低的运输成本。

items.stem: What does the passage say about humour in the workplace?

choices.text: It helps employees to reduce their stress.
choices.zh: 它帮助员工减轻压力。

choices.text: It prevents employees from feeling bored.
choices.zh: 它防止员工感到无聊。

choices.text: It strengthens harmony among employees.
choices.zh: 它增强员工之间的和谐。

choices.text: It helps employees to view things positively.
choices.zh: 它帮助员工积极地看待事物。

items.stem: What does the study by Howard Pollio show?

choices.text: Weekends are conducive to reducing stress.
choices.zh: 周末有助于减轻压力。

choices.text: Humor is vital to interpersonal relationships.
choices.zh: 幽默对人际关系至关重要。

choices.text: All workers experience some emotional stress.
choices.zh: 所有员工都会经历一些情绪压力。

choices.text: Humor can help workers excel at routine tasks.
choices.zh: 幽默可以帮助员工在日常工作中表现出色。

items.stem: What can Kodak's employees do in the Humour Room?

choices.text: Smash the toys to release their bottled-up resentments.
choices.zh: 砸碎玩具以释放他们压抑的怨恨。

choices.text: Take the boss doll apart as long as they reassemble it.
choices.zh: 只要他们重新组装,就可以把老板玩偶拆开。

choices.text: Design and install stress-reducing gadgets.
choices.zh: 设计和安装减压装置。

choices.text: Strike at the boss doll as hard as they like.
choices.zh: 随心所欲地用力击打老板玩偶。

items.stem: What does the speaker say has aroused public interest?

choices.text: The recent finding of a changed gene in obese mice.
choices.zh: 最近在肥胖小鼠体内发现的一个改变的基因。

choices.text: A breakthrough in understanding gene modification.
choices.zh: 在理解基因修饰方面的突破。

choices.text: A newly discovered way for people to lose weight.
choices.zh: 一种新发现的人类减肥方法。

choices.text: The self-repairing ability of a gene in obese mice.
choices.zh: 肥胖小鼠体内一个基因的自我修复能力。

items.stem: What do we learn about the changed gene?

choices.text: It renders an organism unable to fight diseases.
choices.zh: 它使生物体无法对抗疾病。

choices.text: It prevents the mice's fatty tissues from growing.
choices.zh: 它阻止小鼠的脂肪组织生长。

choices.text: It helps organisms adapt to environmental changes.
choices.zh: 它帮助生物体适应环境变化。

choices.text: It renders mice unable to sense when to stop eating.
choices.zh: 它使小鼠无法感知何时停止进食。

items.stem: What does University of Vermont psychologist Esther Rothblum say?

choices.text: Human beings have more obesity genes than most mice do.
choices.zh: 人类拥有的肥胖基因比大多数小鼠多。

choices.text: Half of a person's total weight variation can be controlled.
choices.zh: 一个人总体重变化的一半是可以控制的。

choices.text: People are born with a tendency to have a certain weight.
choices.zh: 人们天生就有保持某一体重的倾向。

choices.text: The function of the obesity genes is yet to be explored.
choices.zh: 肥胖基因的功能尚待探索。

items.stem: What accounts for Americans' obesity according to a survey by the Center for Disease Control?

choices.text: The worsening of natural environment.
choices.zh: 自然环境的恶化。

choices.text: The abundant provision of rich foods.
choices.zh: 丰富食物的充足供应。

choices.text: The accelerated pace of present-day life.
choices.zh: 当今生活节奏的加快。

choices.text: The adverse impact of the food industry.
choices.zh: 食品行业的不利影响。

items.stem: What quality do men value most concerning friendship, according to a questionnaire response?

choices.text: Similarity in interests.
choices.zh: 兴趣相似。

choices.text: Mental stimulation.
choices.zh: 智力上的激发。

choices.text: Openness.
choices.zh: 坦诚。

choices.text: Compassion.
choices.zh: 同情心。

items.stem: What do women refer to when speaking of close friendships?

choices.text: The willingness to offer timely help.
choices.zh: 愿意及时提供帮助。

choices.text: The joy found in each other's company.
choices.zh: 在彼此陪伴中找到的快乐。

choices.text: Personal bonds.
choices.zh: 个人纽带。

choices.text: Emotional factors.
choices.zh: 情感因素。

items.stem: What may threaten a friendship for both men and women?

choices.text: Failure to keep a promise.
choices.zh: 未能信守承诺。

choices.text: Lack of frankness.
choices.zh: 缺乏坦率。

choices.text: Feelings of betrayal.
choices.zh: 背叛的感觉。

choices.text: Loss of contact.
choices.zh: 失去联系。

items.stem: Where can many of the best dinosaur specimens be found in North America?

choices.text: Along the low-lying Colorado River.
choices.zh: 沿着地势低洼的科罗拉多河。

choices.text: At the Dinosaur National Monument.
choices.zh: 在恐龙国家纪念地。

choices.text: Along the border of the U.S. and Canada.
choices.zh: 沿着美国和加拿大的边境。

choices.text: At museums of natural history in large cities.
choices.zh: 在大城市的自然历史博物馆。

items.stem: What occurs to many people when they see the massive bones in the pit wall?

choices.text: Volcanic explosions could bring whole animal species to extinction.
choices.zh: 火山爆发可能导致整个动物物种灭绝。

choices.text: Some natural disaster killed a whole herd of dinosaurs in the area.
choices.zh: 某种自然灾害杀死了该地区的整群恐龙。

choices.text: The pit should be carefully preserved for the study of dinosaurs.
choices.zh: 应该精心保护这个坑以供恐龙研究使用。

choices.text: The whole region must have been struck by a devastating flood.
choices.zh: 整个地区一定遭受过毁灭性的洪水袭击。

items.stem: What does the speaker suggest about the large number of dinosaur bones found in the pit?

choices.text: They floated down an eastward flowing river.
choices.zh: 它们顺着向东流动的河流漂下来。

choices.text: They lay buried deep in the sand for millions of years.
choices.zh: 它们深埋在沙土中达数百万年之久。

choices.text: They were skeletons of dinosaurs inhabiting the locality.
choices.zh: 它们是栖息在该地的恐龙骨架。

choices.text: They were remains of dinosaurs killed in a volcanic explosion.
choices.zh: 它们是在火山爆发中死亡的恐龙遗骸。

items.stem: What have young Americans been accused of?

choices.text: Indulging in seeking leisure and material comfort.
choices.zh: 沉溺于追求闲暇和物质享受。

choices.text: Attaching too much importance to independence.
choices.zh: 过分看重独立性。

choices.text: Failing to care for parents in the traditional way.
choices.zh: 未能以传统方式照顾父母。

choices.text: Leaving their parents on the verge of starvation.
choices.zh: 让他们的父母处于饥饿的边缘。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about old people in the United States?

choices.text: They have great difficulty living by themselves.
choices.zh: 他们独自生活有很大困难。

choices.text: They have little hope of getting any family care.
choices.zh: 他们几乎没有希望得到任何家庭照顾。

choices.text: They have fond memories of their good old days.
choices.zh: 他们对过去的美好时光有着温馨的回忆。

choices.text: They have a sense of independence and autonomy.
choices.zh: 他们有独立和自主意识。

items.stem: What is astonishing to the young mothers interviewed by the speaker?

choices.text: People in many parts of the world preferred small-sized families.
choices.zh: 世界许多地区的人们更喜欢小型家庭。

choices.text: There have been extended families in most parts of the world.
choices.zh: 世界大部分地区一直存在大家庭。

choices.text: Many elderly people were unwilling to take care of their grandchildren.
choices.zh: 许多老年人不愿意照顾他们的孙辈。

choices.text: So many young Americans refused to live together with their parents.
choices.zh: 这么多年轻美国人拒绝与父母住在一起。

items.stem: What does the speaker say older people try their best to do?

choices.text: Leave their younger generations alone.
choices.zh: 让他们的年轻一代独处。

choices.text: Avoid being a burden to their children.
choices.zh: 避免成为子女的负担。

choices.text: Stay healthy by engaging in joyful activities.
choices.zh: 通过参与快乐的活动保持健康。

choices.text: View things from their children's perspective.
choices.zh: 从子女的角度看待事物。
